matches.rationale: Neither finding addresses the conditional Gaussian assumption in Section 3.2 (Assumption 3.2); both findings are entirely focused on the numeric inequality constants in Theorem 3.5 / its Appendix proof, an unrelated piece of material.

Both findings target Theorem 3.5's claimed inequality relating L_flow and L_A (the same theorem/material as GT2), using Lean counterexamples to show the exact constants 2/π² and 4/π² are false for d≥3, which substantiates GT2's concern that the theorem's tight/strict relationship is overoptimistic and needs the approximation/epsilon hedging described in the corrupted text; per R2 the direction (strict vs. hedged) does not break the match.
